international.title: Ministers to end Palantir’s contract with NHS in England in 2029
international.summary: DHSC to extend US tech firm’s contract for two more years to allow time to line up British companies to replace it Ministers will end the NHS’s contract with the controversial tech firm Palantir – but not until 2029, to allow time to line up British companies to replace it. The Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC) has decided to extend Palantir’s contract to provide the federated data platform (FDP) – the software that links different healthcare providers – for two more years rather than exercise a break clause that would have let them axe it next spring.
